about: Boss weapons (Dom + Strategy 2026-10-28): the weapon a boss of a V1 archetype (`opponent`) fights with and is drawn with. KEY (2026-10-28): a row is the archetype's (no `profile`; at most one per archetype, shared by every profile of it) or one profile's own (`profile` = a data/profiles.json id, e.g. castle-guard, anime-boy-black, pumpkinhulk, kachujin, sporty-granny, parasite; its `opponent` must be that profile's archetype; at most one per profile). Many profiles share an archetype (Sir Reginald and Arachne are both shieldmaiden), so a profile's row wins over the archetype's, and a profile with no row of its own falls back to its archetype's row (src/fight/boss-weapon.ts bossWeaponFor), or to V1's weapon when the archetype has none. A ring boss's body finds its profile through its zone spawn (foe-body.ts bodyProfileOf). Gargantua's and Arachne's rows are archetype rows and behave exactly as before. Boss 2 Gargantua is the executioner and wields a MAUL; boss 3 Arachne is the shieldmaiden and wields an AXE in one hand and a SHIELD in the other. Before this a foe's weapon was V1's row for its archetype (the executioner's scythe, the shieldmaiden's gladius). A zone spawn's kind (data/profiles.json, src/fight/spawn-kind.ts kindFightFor) whose `opponent` has a row here fights with `weapon` (a src/fight/weapon-defs.json row: its moves, reach, damage, timing, and V1's hero-rig blade sweeps for it, data/fight.json bladeTables) and is drawn with the same weapon (src/fight/boss-hand.ts, scene.ts). The archetype's guard, stats, specials and AI are untouched, so the shieldmaiden keeps her shield guard and the shield is the drawing of it. `clipsAs`: a 106 body carries no Maul_* or Scythe_* clips, so it plays this weapon's clip family (the sword family, as the Pitborn's cleaver does) until the bodies land with their own. `equip`: the grafted part, a file under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (cleaver = the Pitborn's; maul.glb = library hammer-01, axe.glb = library axe1h-208, shield.glb = library shield-213, sword.glb = library sword1h-200 (Ryo's plain sword, profile anime-boy-black): re-framed OpenTrident library props Dom picked 2026-10-28, licence ruled no concern). `scale`: the drawn part scaled about its grip. `offhand`: a part on the other hand (null = none); kind `file` is a mesh under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (`file` = stem, root node BossShield, metres, face normal +Z; `scale` about its origin), loaded only with the boss body (its URL: FOE_OFFHAND_URLS in src/fight/scene.ts) and seated on `hand` at `offset` metres, `rotationDeg` Euler XYZ; kind `disc` (still supported) is a flat round board built in code (no file) sized in METRES in world space (`radius`, `thickness`), seated on `hand` at `offset` metres with `rotationDeg` Euler XYZ in that bone's frame. MOUNTING knobs (2026-10-28): `equip` is the part's file stem under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (to drop in an OpenTrident GLB: put the file there, add its one-line URL to FOE_EQUIP_URLS in src/fight/scene.ts and the stem to PACKED in scripts/build.mjs, name it here); `scale` grows the DRAWN part about its grip (the grafted node under the Grip106 seat; before, the socket bone was scaled, which moved nothing drawn); `grip` {offset metres, rotationDeg Euler XYZ} nudges the drawn part in the seat frame (the sim's reach is V1's blade tables and is untouched); `material` {colour, metalness, roughness} replaces the part's own look (null = the file's; the Pitborn's cleaver is near-black and vanished against Arachne's dark legs, so the placeholder wears iron grey). The shield `offhand` is parented to `hand` (lowerarm_l); its board axis (the face normal) is the board's local Y rotated by `rotationDeg` in the forearm's frame: on a Mixamo left forearm Y runs elbow to wrist, -Z is the back of the forearm (away from the palm), so rotationDeg [-90,0,0] puts the face outward and `offset` [0, 0.14, -0.07] seats it between elbow and wrist with a small gap (radius, thickness, offset, rotationDeg are the tuning knobs; scripts/boss-walkin-stills.mjs METRIC=1 prints the clearance to head and chest). `placeholder`: exactly what is a stand-in, so nobody mistakes it for art. Presentation and the sim's weapon id only; the archetype's other rows are untouched. ?bossweapon=v1 puts every boss back on V1's weapon (and the drawn part); ?bossweapon=<opponent id> (stills) draws that row's weapon on the page's own foe (the Minotaur body) without changing the sim. Rows are checked by src/sim/validate.js (keys) and src/fight/boss-weapon.ts validateBossWeapons (values), at load.
